\begin{abstract}
We study a toy estimator of the mean $\mu \in \R$.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
Estimating a mean is an old problem~\cite{gauss1809}. % a comment that is not text
We revisit it, e.g.\ for short segments, and we show that the bias vanishes.\footnote{The proof is in Sec.~\ref{sec:method}.}
Is it consistent? The answer is yes \citep{fisher1925,gauss1809}.
